check_fishbase_update(): 检查FishBase和SeaLifeBase的最新版本

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/check_fishbase_update.Rmd
check_fishbase_update.Rmd

英文原页：check_fishbase_update()

说明

本函数列出网上发布的FishBase和SeaLifeBase版本（rfishbase包使用的静态快照），并把其中最新的版本与本机已下载的版本进行比较。

English

This function lists the FishBase and SeaLifeBase releases published online (the static snapshots used by the rfishbase package) and compares the newest with the releases downloaded on this computer.

用法 

check_fishbase_update(
  server = c("fishbase", "sealifebase"),
  data_dir = fao_data_dir(),
  quiet = FALSE
)

参数

server
“fishbase”、“sealifebase”或两者（默认）。
English “fishbase”, “sealifebase” or both (default).
data_dir
下载数据的保存目录。默认为fao_data_dir()。
English The directory where downloaded data is stored. Default is fao_data_dir().
quiet
逻辑值。为TRUE时不显示任何信息。默认为FALSE。
English A logical value. If TRUE, no message is printed. Default is FALSE.

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个数据框，每个数据库（server）一行：网上最新的版本（离线时为NA）、本机已下载的最新版本、网上和本机已下载的数据表数量，以及是否有可用的更新（update_available：本机没有已下载的版本或网上有更新的版本时为TRUE；某个版本只下载了本包所需的数据表时，也视为最新）。

English

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per server: newest online release (NA when offline), newest downloaded release, number of tables online and downloaded, and whether an update is available (update_available: TRUE when nothing has been downloaded or a newer release is online; a release of which only the tables the package needs were downloaded is up to date).

参考文献

Froese, R. and Pauly, D. (Eds.) FishBase. World Wide Web electronic publication. https://www.fishbase.se

Palomares, M.L.D. and Pauly, D. (Eds.) SeaLifeBase. World Wide Web electronic publication. https://www.sealifebase.se

Boettiger, C., Lang, D.T. and Wainwright, P.C. (2012). rfishbase: exploring, manipulating and visualizing FishBase data from R. Journal of Fish Biology 81(6): 2030-2039. doi:10.1111/j.1095-8649.2012.03464.x. Source code: https://github.com/ropensci/rfishbase

示例 

check_fishbase_update()
